messages:
mira: Quick design review — updated badges + traffic controls for the Deployments page. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/rollouts
mira: Main things I'd like eyes on: compact badges (paused / healthy / degraded), traffic slider microcopy, and keyboard/focus states for the slider. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example
devin: Love the compact look. Can we pair color + icon instead of color-only? worried about relying on color alone for state. :thinking:
sam: a11y note: absolutely yes to icon + text. Also add sr-only text for screen readers, and ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for badge bg/text.
julia: Copy tweak suggestion: change the label from 'Traffic' to 'Canary traffic' (more explicit). Tooltip: 'percent of requests routed' -> 'percent of requests routed to this version (approx)'.
mira: updated copy in the Figma file and moved tooltip trigger to both hover + focus. can someone sanity-check keyboard flow?
mika: Keyboard/a11y checklist: slider must be focusable, support arrow keys for small increments, page up/down for bigger jumps, and announce value changes via an aria-live region.
devin: technical ask: slider snap points should be [0,5,10,25,50,100]. Also what should the API param be named? current backend has `canary_pct` and `allocation_percent` in different places.
sam: prefer allocation_percent (consistent with autoscaling naming). Backend OK with that. Front-end should send integer percentages. Also add a 300ms debounce on updates to avoid rapid requests.
julia: UX: When a user drags slider, do we show an inline 'saving…' vs a transient toast? I lean inline tiny status under the slider so it doesn't steal focus.
mira: agree inline status looks less noisy — will prototype 'saving' → 'saved' under slider. Also thinking about the paused state: when allocation is 0, we show a 'Paused' badge. Should the slider be disabled or still editable?
sam: if allocation=0, allow direct keyboard input or open a modal to confirm increasing traffic (to avoid accidental releases). disabling the handle hides affordance though.
julia: UX preference: hide handle and show a clear 'Resume canary' action that opens the modal to set allocation. clearer for less experienced users.
mika: implement aria-labels for the action and ensure modal autofocus moves to the allocation input. also ensure the 'Paused' badge has aria-describedby pointing to reason text when applicable.
mira: great notes. I'll update the Figma mock and component spec. Action items I captured:
- add icon + visible text for badges, include sr-only span for screen readers
- use allocation_percent as the API field, send integers
- slider: snap points at 0/5/10/25/50/100, 300ms debounce, announce with aria-live
- copy: 'Canary traffic' + updated tooltip copy
- paused behavior: hide handle, surface 'Resume canary' modal path
- inline saving indicator under slider
I'll follow up with a short PR once components are updated. thanks all :thumbsup:
devin: leaving a tiny CSS snippet for sr-only that we can use in the components:
```css
.sr-only {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}
```
sam: noted. i'll add unit tests for keyboard interaction and aria announcements.
julia: I'll post a quick alt text example for the badges in Figma comments.
mira: Awesome — leaving this thread open for any late nits. I'll ping when the PR is up.
